steps: Launch the Headspace app and navigate to the meditation log screen
Complete a short meditation session (e.g., 5 minutes)
Tap the 'Log' button to save the workout without entering detailed information
tests.expected_result: The meditation session is logged within 5 seconds of tapping the 'Log' button with a timestamp and duration
tests.notes: This test was written to validate the 'quick log' functionality for frequent fitness loggers who value efficiency

steps: Launch the Headspace app and navigate to the meditation session screen
Start a meditation session and allow it to run for 5 minutes
Simulate a phone call notification while the meditation session is in progress
tests.expected_result: The meditation session continues uninterrupted and the timer keeps running
tests.notes: This test was written to validate the requirement from the perspective of a Frequent Fitness Logger who values uninterrupted tracking of their activities.

steps: Launch the Headspace app and navigate to the meditation log section
Complete a meditation session and attempt to save it
Simulate a network interruption or force-close the app during the save process
tests.expected_result: The app does not crash and the meditation session is saved successfully when the network interruption is resolved or the app is relaunched
tests.notes: This test was written to simulate a real-world scenario where a user may experience network issues or accidentally force-close the app while saving a workout, as per the Frequent Fitness Logger persona.

tests.scenario: Activity data loss on app restart
steps: Launch the Headspace app and log in to an existing account
Enter and save activity data for a meditation session
Restart the app and verify if the previously entered activity data is still present
tests.expected_result: The previously entered activity data is retained and displayed upon app restart
tests.notes: This test was written to address the concern of data loss for Frequent Fitness Loggers who rely on tracking their activity
